decisions.reason: The chair family sits close to the core range and uses existing craft and distribution, so it likely meets aspirations at low carrying cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

Floor cushions are a niche accessory whose website visibility lapsed after 2018, which signals weak results, but their shared material base with the rug line and the firm's slack make continued carrying slightly more likely than withdrawal.

The upholstered sofa fits the core living offer and costs little to keep, though its low visibility and the post-pandemic margin pressure on furniture makers leave a moderate risk that it falls short of aspirations.
The rug collection is presented as a flagship of the firm's strategic direction, so management will tolerate uncertain results through slack rather than withdraw a symbol of where it is heading.
